title: Micro Projects
description: These projects were built while learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Each project helped me understand core web development concepts, improve problem-solving skills, and gain hands-on coding experience.

projects.name: Retro Snake Game
projects.description: A modern implementation of the classic Snake game with a retro monochrome aesthetic, responsive design, and enhanced gameplay features. Built with HTML5 Canvas, it includes multiple difficulty levels, special food items, sound effects, mobile touch controls, and score persistence via LocalStorage.
projects.overview: This Snake Game is a modern take on the classic game that was popular on early mobile phones. It features a clean, monochrome aesthetic with a retro pixel art style. The game is fully responsive and works on both desktop and mobile devices. It uses a RequestAnimationFrame-based game loop for smooth animation and a 20x20 grid system for the game board.
keyFeatures: Multiple difficulty levels — Easy, Medium, Hard (speed: 5/9/15)
Special food items worth 3–5 bonus points (disappear after 5 seconds)
Pause/Resume functionality with Space Bar or on-screen button
Sound toggle for background and effect audio
Speed adjustment slider
Mobile touch controls — on-screen directional buttons
High score persistence via LocalStorage
Countdown (3, 2, 1, GO!) before game starts
Retro monochrome pixel art aesthetic
Responsive layout for desktop, tablet, and mobile

projects.name: Professional Calculator
projects.description: A professional calculator built with HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript that correctly evaluates BODMAS expressions using a custom two-pass safe parser (no eval()), converts numeric results into Hindi words, and supports full keyboard shortcuts and sound effects.
projects.overview: This calculator goes beyond basic arithmetic — it evaluates full expressions like '2+3+7-6*2' with correct operator precedence (BODMAS: multiplication/division before addition/subtraction) using a custom-built tokenizer and two-pass parser. Results are automatically converted into Hindi Devanagari words (e.g., '5' displays as 'पाँच'). The design uses a monochrome glassmorphism aesthetic with Google Fonts (Inter + Noto Sans Devanagari) for bilingual typography.
keyFeatures: BODMAS expression evaluation — correct operator precedence without eval()
Custom two-pass safe expression parser (Tokenizer → Pass 1: */ → Pass 2: +-)
Hindi word conversion for results (e.g., 5 → पाँच, 0 → शून्य)
Full keyboard support — numbers, operators, Enter, Escape, Backspace
Sound effects on button clicks and calculation
Monochrome glassmorphism UI design
Responsive design — works on all devices
Bilingual typography with Devanagari font support
learning: Web Audio API for sound effects

projects.name: Advocate Atul Pal — Legal Website
projects.description: A modern, professional, fully responsive multi-page website for Advocate Atul Pal — a legal practitioner specializing in Civil, Criminal, Property, Family, and Constitutional Law. Features a modular CSS and JS architecture, scroll animations, form validation, and an elegant gold-on-black legal design system.
projects.overview: This project is a professional legal website built for Advocate Atul Pal. It consists of 5 pages (Home, About, Services, Cases, Contact) each with dedicated CSS and JS modules — implementing a clean separation of concerns. The design uses a prestigious Black (#1a1a1a) and Gold (#d4af37) color palette with Playfair Display serif headings for an authoritative legal aesthetic. The project was a significant learning milestone for modular CSS architecture, component-based JS patterns, and real-world multi-page website structure.
techStack: Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Inter, Crimson Text)
keyFeatures: 5-page website — Home, About, Services, Cases, Contact
Modular CSS architecture — each page has its own CSS file
Modular JS architecture — each page has its own JS module
Legal services timeline with step-by-step process visualization
Interactive case filtering and search functionality
Real-time contact form validation
Loading animations and scroll-triggered element reveals
Gold (#d4af37) and black legal color palette
Playfair Display serif typography for authoritative headings
Fully responsive — mobile-first with breakpoints at 480px, 768px, 1200px
WCAG accessible design
SEO-optimized semantic HTML structure
Legacy files preserved in /legacy directory for reference
learning: Modular CSS architecture with component-level stylesheets
JavaScript module pattern and page-specific code splitting
CSS BEM methodology for class naming

projects.name: Personal Portfolio v1
projects.description: My first personal portfolio website built with HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript. Features a monochrome glassmorphism design, interactive particle background, an animated jellyfish hero section, VanillaTilt.js card effects, filterable project and skill sections, a certificate lightbox gallery, and full SEO optimization with JSON-LD structured data.
projects.overview: This is the first version of my personal portfolio — a feature-rich website that showcases my early projects, skills, certificates, and achievements. The portfolio is notable for its interactive animated hero (LottieFiles jellyfish that reacts to mouse movement), Particles.js background, 3D card tilt effects via VanillaTilt.js, and a comprehensive certificate gallery with lightbox viewing and download capability. The site is fully SEO-optimized with sitemap.xml, robots.txt, Open Graph tags, Twitter Cards, and JSON-LD structured data (Schema.org Person markup). The design uses an elegant monochrome aesthetic with glassmorphism card elements.
keyFeatures: Interactive jellyfish hero animation (LottieFiles) that reacts to mouse movement
Dynamic particle background (Particles.js) with mouse interaction
3D card tilt hover effect via VanillaTilt.js on project, skill, and achievement cards
Typewriter animation cycling through different developer roles
Tabbed About section — Bio, Education, Certifications
Filterable Projects section — Web Apps, Games, Other
Skills section with category filtering and visual progress indicators
Certificate gallery with grid view, lightbox, navigation, and download functionality
Keyboard navigation support (arrow keys, Escape) in lightbox
Lazy loading for all images (30–50% faster initial load)
SEO optimization — sitemap.xml, robots.txt, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD
Schema.org Person structured data for rich Google results
Contact form with validation
Fully responsive — hamburger menu on mobile
learning: SEO optimization with structured data and Open Graph
